---
title: "Youtube API Test"
format: html
editor: visual
---

```{r}
library(httr)
library(jsonlite)

response <- GET(
  "https://www.googleapis.com/youtube/v3/videos",
  query = list(
    part = "snippet",
    id = "pEBI0vF45ic",
    key = youtube_key
  )
)

# Check the response status
status_code(response)

# Read the returned data
result <- fromJSON(
  content(response, "text", encoding = "UTF-8")
)

# Display the result
result


str(result)

cat(prettify(content(response, "text", encoding = "UTF-8")))

View(result$items)



response <- GET(
  "https://www.googleapis.com/youtube/v3/videos",
  query = list(
    part = "snippet,statistics,contentDetails,status",
    id = "pEBI0vF45ic",
    key = youtube_key
  )
)

result <- fromJSON(
  content(response, "text", encoding = "UTF-8")
)

View(result$items)



result$items$snippet$title

# View count
result$items$statistics$viewCount

# Duration
result$items$contentDetails$duration




# List the snippet field names
names(result$items$snippet)

# Inspect their contents
str(result$items$snippet)


result$items$snippet$title
result$items$snippet$description
```
